sources.title: Zimbabwe eVisa FAQ and nationality visa regime
sources.officialityEvidence: The live eVisa portal gives Department of Immigration contact details and describes its visa-regime lists and electronic-application process.

unresolved.reason: Fallback evisa is not established. The current Department of Immigration Category B page names Bolivia and expressly permits paid visa issuance at the port of entry; the current official eVisa FAQ instead places Bolivia among visitors required to obtain a visa before travel. The FAQ's general eVisa availability and emails do not resolve whether a Bolivian ordinary-passport visitor must obtain an electronic visa in advance or may use the direct arrival route. No dated amendment or controlling hierarchy reconciles the two official sources.
